Beta release — please send feedback from Help › Send Feedback.

Improvements

  • Privacy Mode hides the toolbar too. While it's on, each window shows only the blur and a Show Mail button. Press ⌃⌘P or click Show Mail to bring everything back.

Beta release — please send feedback from Help › Send Feedback.

What's new

  • Privacy Mode. For when someone comes by your desk. Click the sunglasses in the toolbar, or press ⌃⌘P (also under View and in the menu bar). Every Normal Mail window is blurred and new mail stops showing notifications. Widgets and the menu bar's unread list are hidden too. Click Show Mail or press ⌃⌘P again to turn it off.

Improvements

  • Long recipient lists show the first three names, then "and N more".
  • A warning about a fake sender now wraps onto more lines instead of being cut off.

Beta release — please send feedback from Help › Send Feedback.

Bug fixes

  • Widgets show up reliably. Normal Mail's widgets are now Inbox, Starred and Sign-In Code. The Inbox widget could stay blank on some Macs. To show a single account in the widgets, choose it in Settings › General › Widgets.
